title: Sanitation Commercial Services
categories: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
description: Use to request new commercial roll cart and/or dumpster service, make changes to the existing commercial service, or cancel service. Businesses, City Facilities, and Multi-Family Properties can request commercial roll cart services. ONLY CITY FACILITIES can request Dumpster Service. If you live in a Multi-Family Property, i.e., apartment/condo/townhome, your service will be approved on a case-by-case basis. All service addresses considered business/commercial must have an active Dallas Water Utilities account with active water to proceed with this request. A signed Commercial Service Agreement must also be obtained to provide/continue service. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 3 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to start, change, or stop commercial roll-cart service.
actions.why: For a business, City facility, or multifamily property seeking new commercial garbage or recycling roll carts, changes or repairs to existing commercial service, pricing information, or cancellation. Dumpster service is described as available only to City facilities. Commercial addresses need an active Dallas Water Utilities water account and a signed Commercial Service Agreement; multifamily requests are reviewed case by case.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Sanitation Commercial Services" requests cannot be used for a single-family home; its conditional guidance directs that answer to "Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery". If the property is a single-family home, then submit a "Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery" 311 request instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Commercial Services"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Commercial Services"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for dumpster service at a City facility.
actions.why: For a City of Dallas facility seeking new dumpster service or a change to it. The Sanitation Commercial Services description says only City facilities can request dumpster service, and the 311 request form asks for the department and facility names.
actions.why_not: The dumpster-service action does not apply to businesses or multifamily properties; the description for "Sanitation Commercial Services" requests on the Dallas 311 website limits dumpster requests to City facilities.
